packageRules.description: Automerge Docker patch, minor, and digest updates. Critical infrastructure opts back out in a later rule.

Home Assistant's monthly release (2026.9 -> 2026.10) is a minor to Renovate but carries breaking changes, so it waits for review in its own PR. Patches (2026.9.x) keep automerging. Placed after the automerge rule so it overrides it.
Critical infrastructure: never automerge, collect every update type into one PR. Placed after the automerge rule so it overrides it, which keeps the package list in exactly one place.

Estate images deploy khe-ai-adventure: its web and proxy images come from one commit and move in one PR, as soon as a new digest appears. Top priority so the PR concurrency limit never holds a deploy behind updates that wait for review. A rollback pin on a sha- tag has a digest that never moves, so Renovate leaves it alone.
